definitions.explanation: A formal name for the United States of America, commonly used in news, official documents, and formal writing.

examples.japanese: {米国|べいこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I studied abroad in the United States.

examples.japanese: {米国|べいこく}{大統領|だいとうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来日|らいにち}→来日：13060_rainichi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{米国|べいこく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{密接|みっせつ}→密接：12289_missetsu⟧な⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japan and the United States have a close economic relationship.

notes:
A formal abbreviation of {亜米利加合衆国|あめりかがっしゅうこく} (United States of America). The kanji ⟦{米|べい}→米：28297_bei⟧ was chosen as a phonetic representation of the first syllable of "America" (メ). Standard in news, politics, and formal writing.

USAGE:
Used primarily in news media, official documents, and formal writing. In everyday conversation, ⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧ is far more common. The ⟦{米|べい}→米：28297_bei⟧ prefix appears in many compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {米国|べいこく}{大統領|だいとうりょう} — U.S. president
- {米国|べいこく}⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧ — U.S. government
- ⟦{日米|にちべい}→日米：13092_nichibei⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ — Japan-U.S. relations
- {在米|ざいべい} — residing in America
- ⟦{訪米|ほうべい}→訪米：22848_houbei⟧ — a visit to America

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧ — America; the everyday word used in casual and neutral contexts
- {合衆国|がっしゅうこく} — the United States; an abbreviation of the full formal name, less common than {米国|べいこく}
